name: NIST SP 800-172
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: Enhanced security requirements supplementing NIST SP 800-171 for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in nonfederal systems against advanced persistent threats. The source of the CMMC Level 3 requirements.

controls.label: Dual Authorization
controls.description: Enforce dual authorization for [Assignment: organization-defined privileged commands and/or other organization-defined actions].

controls.label: Non-Organizationally Owned Systems - Restricted Use
controls.description: Restrict the use of non-organizationally owned systems or system components to process, store, or transmit CUI using [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions].

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Concurrent Session Control
controls.description: Limit the number of concurrent sessions for each [Assignment: organization-defined account and/or account type] to [Assignment: organization-defined number].

controls.label: Remote Access Monitoring and Control
controls.description: Employ automated mechanisms to monitor and control remote access methods.

controls.label: Protection of Remote Access Mechanism Information
controls.description: Protect information about remote access mechanisms from unauthorized use and disclosure.

controls.label: Automated Audit Actions for Account Management
controls.description: Use automated mechanisms to audit account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal actions.

controls.label: Account Monitoring for Atypical Usage
controls.description:
ES-03.01.08E-a Monitor system accounts for [Assignment: organization-defined atypical usage].
ES-03.01.08E-b Report atypical usage of system accounts to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.label: Attribute-Based Access Control
controls.description:
ES-03.01.09E-a Enforce attribute-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects.
ES-03.01.09E-b Control access based upon [Assignment: organization-defined attributes to assume access permissions].

controls.label: Object Security Attributes
controls.description: Use [Assignment: organization-defined security attributes] associated with [Assignment: organization-defined security attributes] to enforce [Assignment: organization-defined security attributes] as a basis for flow control decisions.

controls.label: Role-Based Access Control
controls.description:
ES-03.01.11E-a Enforce a role-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects.
ES-03.01.11E-b Control access based upon [Assignment: organization-defined roles and users authorized to assume such roles].

controls.label: Physical or Logical Separation of CUI Flows
controls.description: Separate CUI flows logically or physically using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms and/or techniques].

controls.label: Metadata
controls.description: Enforce information flow control based on [Assignment: organization-defined metadata].

controls.label: Security Policy Filters
controls.description:
ES-03.01.14E-a Enforce information flow control using [Assignment: organization-defined security policy filters] as a basis for flow control decisions for [Assignment: organization-defined information flows].
ES-03.01.14E-b [Selection (one or more): Block; Strip; Modify; Quarantine] data after a filter processing failure in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security policy].

controls.label: Data Type Identifiers
controls.description: Use [Assignment: organization-defined data type identifiers] to validate data that is essential for information flow decisions when transferring CUI between security domains.

controls.label: Decomposition Into Policy-Relevant Subcomponents
controls.description: Decompose CUI into [Assignment: organization-defined policy-relevant subcomponents] for submission to policy enforcement mechanisms when transferring CUI between different security domains.

controls.label: Detection of Unsanctioned CUI
controls.description:
ES-03.01.17E-a Examine CUI for the presence of [Assignment: organization-defined unsanctioned information] when transferring information between different security domains.
ES-03.01.17E-b Prohibit the transfer of the CUI defined in 03.01.17E.a in accordance with the [Assignment: organization-defined security policy].

controls.label: Advanced Literacy and Awareness Training
controls.description:
ES-03.02.01E-a Provide security literacy training to system users:
  ES-03.02.01E-a-1 On the advanced persistent threat,
  ES-03.02.01E-a-2 On recognizing suspicious communications and anomalous behavior in systems using [Assignment: organization-defined indicators of malicious code], and
  ES-03.02.01E-a-3 On the cyber threat environment.
ES-03.02.01E-b Update security literacy training content [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.label: Literacy and Awareness Training Practical Exercises
controls.description: Provide practical exercises in literacy training that simulate events and incidents.

controls.label: Literacy and Awareness Training Feedback
controls.description: Provide feedback on organizational training results to the following personnel [Assignment: organization-defined personnel].

controls.label: Anti-Counterfeit Training
controls.description: Train [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] to detect counterfeit system components.

controls.label: Protection of Audit Record Storage in Separate Physical Systems or Components
controls.description: Store audit records in a repository that is part of a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited.

controls.label: Real-Time Alerts for Audit Processing Failures
controls.description: Provide an alert within [Assignment: organization-defined real-time period] to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel, roles, and/or locations] when the following audit failure events occur: [Assignment: organization-defined audit logging failure events requiring real-time alerts].

controls.label: Dual Authorization for Audit Information and Actions
controls.description: Enforce dual authorization for [Selection (one or more): movement; deletion] of [Assignment: organization-defined audit information].

controls.label: Integrated Analysis of Audit Records
controls.description: Integrate analysis of audit records with analysis of [Selection (one or more): vulnerability scanning information; performance data; system monitoring information; {{ insert: param, A.03.03.04E.ODP.02 }} ] to further enhance the ability to identify inappropriate or unusual activity.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Automated Unauthorized Component Detection
controls.description:
ES-03.04.02E-a Detect the presence of unauthorized or misconfigured system components using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].
ES-03.04.02E-b Take the following actions when unauthorized or misconfigured components are detected: [Selection (one or more): disable network access by such components; isolate the components; notify {{ insert: param, A.03.04.02E.ODP.03 }} ].

controls.label: Automated Maintenance of System Component Inventory
controls.description: Maintain the currency, completeness, accuracy, and availability of the inventory of system components using [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Automation Support for Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Maintain the currency, completeness, accuracy, and availability of the baseline configuration of the system using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Dual Authorization for System Changes
controls.description: Enforce dual authorization for implementing changes to [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined system components and system-level information].

controls.label: Retention of Previous Configurations
controls.description: Retain [Assignment: organization-defined number] previous versions of baseline configurations of the system to support rollback.

controls.label: Testing, Validation, and Documentation of Changes
controls.description: Test, validate, and document changes to the system before finalizing the implementation of the changes.

controls.label: Centralized Repository
controls.description: Provide a centralized repository for the inventory of system components.

controls.label: Cryptographic Bidirectional Authentication
controls.description: Authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined devices and/or types of devices] before establishing a system connection using bidirectional authentication that is cryptographically based.

controls.label: Password Managers
controls.description:
ES-03.05.02E-a Employ [Assignment: organization-defined password managers] to generate and manage passwords.
ES-03.05.02E-b Protect the passwords using [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.label: Device Attestation
controls.description: Handle device identification and authentication based on attestation by [Assignment: organization-defined configuration management process].

controls.label: No Embedded Unencrypted Static Authenticators
controls.description: Ensure that unencrypted static authenticators are not embedded in applications or other forms of static storage.

controls.label: Expiration of Cached Authenticators
controls.description: Prohibit the use of cached authenticators after [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: Identity Proofing
controls.description:
ES-03.05.06E-a Identity proof users that require accounts for logical access to systems based on appropriate identity assurance level requirements as specified in applicable standards and guidelines.
ES-03.05.06E-b Resolve user identities to a unique individual.
ES-03.05.06E-c Collect, validate, and verify identity evidence.

controls.label: Identity Providers and Authorization Servers
controls.description: Employ identity providers and authorization servers to manage user, device, and non-person entity identities, attributes, and access rights that support authentication and authorization decisions in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined identification and authentication policy] using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms].

controls.label: Security Operations Center
controls.description: Establish and maintain a security operations center.

controls.label: Integrated Incident Response Team
controls.description: Establish and maintain an integrated incident response team that can be deployed to any location identified by the organization in [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: Behavior Analysis
controls.description: Analyze anomalous or suspected adversarial behavior in or related to [Assignment: organization-defined environments or resources].

controls.label: Automated Tracking, Data Collection, and Analysis for Incident Monitoring
controls.description: Track incidents and collect and analyze incident information using [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Software Updates and Patches for Maintenance Tools
controls.description: Inspect maintenance tools to ensure the latest software updates and patches are installed.

controls.label: Dual Authorization for Media Sanitization
controls.description: Enforce dual authorization for the sanitization of [Assignment: organization-defined system media containing CUI].

controls.label: Dual Authorization for System Backup Deletion and Destruction
controls.description: Enforce dual authorization for the deletion or destruction of [Assignment: organization-defined system backup information].

controls.label: Testing System Backups for Reliability and Integrity
controls.description: Test backup information [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined frequency] to verify media reliability and information integrity.

controls.label: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.description: Provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state within [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined time period consistent with recovery time and recovery point objectives] after a disruption, compromise, or failure.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Access Agreements
controls.description:
ES-03.09.03E-a Develop and document access agreements for systems processing, storing, or transmitting CUI.
ES-03.09.03E-b Review and update the access agreements [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined frequency].
ES-03.09.03E-c Verify that individuals requiring access to CUI and systems processing, storing, or transmitting CUI:
  ES-03.09.03E-c-1 Sign appropriate access agreements prior to being granted access; and
  ES-03.09.03E-c-2 Re-sign access agreements to maintain access to systems when access agreements have been updated or [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: Citizenship Requirements
controls.description: Verify that individuals accessing a system that processes, stores, or transmits CUI meet [Assignment: organization-defined citizenship requirements].

controls.label: Intrusion Alarms and Surveillance Equipment
controls.description: Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides using physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment.

controls.label: Delivery and Removal of System Components
controls.description:
ES-03.10.02E-a Authorize and control [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined types of system components] entering and exiting the facility.
ES-03.10.02E-b Maintain records of the system components.

controls.label: Threat Awareness Program
controls.description: Implement a threat awareness program that includes a cross-organization information-sharing capability for threat intelligence.

controls.label: Threat Hunting
controls.description:
ES-03.11.02E-a Establish and maintain a cyber threat-hunting capability to:
  ES-03.11.02E-a-1 Search for indicators of compromise in organizational systems and
  ES-03.11.02E-a-2 Detect, track, and disrupt threats that evade existing safeguards.
ES-03.11.02E-b Employ the threat-hunting capability [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: Predictive Cyber Analytics
controls.description: Employ the following advanced automation and analytics capabilities to predict and identify risks to [Assignment: organization-defined advanced automation and analytics capabilities]: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Dynamic Threat Awareness
controls.description: Determine the current cyber threat environment on an ongoing basis using [Assignment: organization-defined means].

controls.label: Indicators of Compromise
controls.description: Discover, collect, and distribute to [Assignment: organization-defined sources], indicators of compromise provided by [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.label: Criticality Analysis
controls.description: Identify critical system components and functions by performing a criticality analysis for [Assignment: organization-defined systems, system components, or system services] at [Assignment: organization-defined decision points in the system development life cycle].

controls.label: Discoverable Information
controls.description: Determine information about the system that is discoverable and take [Assignment: organization-defined corrective actions].

controls.label: Automated Means for Sharing Threat Intelligence
controls.description: Employ automated mechanisms to maximize the effectiveness of sharing threat intelligence information.

controls.label: Penetration Testing
controls.description: Conduct penetration testing [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.label: Independent Assessors
controls.description: Use independent assessors or assessment teams to conduct security requirement assessments.

controls.label: Risk Monitoring
controls.description: Ensure risk monitoring is an integral part of the continuous monitoring strategy that includes effectiveness monitoring, compliance monitoring, change monitoring.

controls.label: Internal System Connections
controls.description:
ES-03.12.04E-a Authorize internal connections of [Assignment: organization-defined system components or classes of components] to the system.
ES-03.12.04E-b Document, for each internal connection, the interface characteristics, security requirements, and the nature of the information communicated.
ES-03.12.04E-c Terminate internal system connections after [Assignment: organization-defined conditions].
ES-03.12.04E-d Review [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] the continued need for each internal connection.

controls.label: Heterogeneity
controls.description: Employ a diverse set of information technologies for the following system components in the implementation of the system: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Randomness
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined techniques] to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets.

controls.label: Concealment and Misdirection
controls.description: Employ the following concealment and misdirection techniques to mislead adversaries: [Assignment: organization-defined concealment and misdirection techniques].

controls.label: Isolation of System Components
controls.description: Employ boundary protection mechanisms to isolate [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Change Processing and Storage Locations
controls.description: Change the location of [Selection: {{ insert: param, A.03.13.05E.ODP.03 }}; at random time intervals] [Assignment: organization-defined processing and/or storage].

controls.label: Platform-Independent Applications
controls.description: Include within organizational systems the following platform independent applications: [Assignment: organization-defined platform-independent applications].

controls.label: Virtualization Techniques
controls.description: Employ virtualization techniques to support the deployment of a diversity of operating systems and applications that are changed [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: Decoys
controls.description: Include components within organizational systems specifically designed to be the target of malicious attacks for detecting, deflecting, and analyzing such attacks.

controls.label: Isolation of Security Tools, Mechanisms, and Support Components
controls.description: Isolate [Assignment: organization-defined information security tools, mechanisms, and support components] from other internal system components by implementing physically separate subnetworks with managed interfaces to other components of the system.

controls.label: Separate Subnetworks
controls.description: Implement separate network addresses to connect to systems in different security domains.

controls.label: Thin Nodes
controls.description: Employ minimal functionality and information storage on the following system components: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.description:
ES-03.13.12E-a [Assignment: organization-defined types of denial-of-service events] the effects of the following types of denial-of-service events: [Selection: Protect against; Limit].
ES-03.13.12E-b Employ the following safeguards to prevent the denial-of-service events [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards by type of denial-of-service event].

controls.label: Port and Input/Output Device Access
controls.description: [Assignment: organization-defined connection ports or input/output devices] disable or remove [Selection: Physically; Logically] on the following systems or system components: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.label: Detonation Chambers
controls.description: Employ a detonation chamber capability within [Assignment: organization-defined system, system component, or location].

controls.label: Separate Subnets to Isolate System Components and Functions
controls.description: Implement [Selection: physically; logically] separate subnetworks to isolate the following critical system components and functions: [Assignment: organization-defined critical system components and functions].

controls.label: System Partitioning
controls.description: Partition the system into [Selection: physical; logical] residing in separate [Assignment: organization-defined system components] domains or environments based on [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances for physical or logical separation of components].

controls.label: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.description:
ES-03.14.01E-a Employ integrity verification tools to detect unauthorized changes to the following software, firmware, and information: [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined software, firmware, and information].
ES-03.14.01E-b Take the following actions when unauthorized changes to the software, firmware, and information are detected: [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined actions].

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Refresh From Trusted Sources
controls.description: Obtain software and data employed during system component and service refreshes from the following trusted sources: [Assignment: organization-defined trusted sources].

controls.label: Non-Persistent Information
controls.description:
ES-03.14.05E-a [Selection: Refresh {{ insert: param, A.03.14.05E.ODP.02 }} {{ insert: param, A.03.14.05E.ODP.03 }}; Generate {{ insert: param, A.03.14.05E.ODP.04 }} on demand ].
ES-03.14.05E-b Delete information when no longer needed.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Withdrawn
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Integrity Checks
controls.description: Perform an integrity check of [Assignment: organization-defined organization-defined software, firmware, and information] [Selection (one or more): at startup; at {{ insert: param, A.03.14.08E.ODP.03 }}; {{ insert: param, A.03.14.08E.ODP.04 }} ].

controls.label: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information.

controls.label: Protection of Boot Firmware
controls.description: Implement the following mechanisms to protect the integrity of boot firmware in [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms]: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Integration of Detection and Response
controls.description: Incorporate the detection of the following unauthorized changes into the organizational incident response capability: [Assignment: organization-defined security-relevant changes to the system].

controls.label: Information Input Validation
controls.description: Check the validity of the following information inputs: [Assignment: organization-defined information inputs to the system].

controls.label: Error Handling
controls.description:
ES-03.14.13E-a Generate error messages that provide information necessary for corrective actions without revealing information that could be exploited.
ES-03.14.13E-b Reveal error messages only to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.label: Memory Protection
controls.description: Implement the following safeguards to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution: [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards].

controls.label: Non-Persistent System Components and Services
controls.description:
ES-03.14.15E-a Implement non-persistent [Assignment: organization-defined system components and services].
ES-03.14.15E-b Initiate non-persistent [Assignment: organization-defined system components and services] from a known state.
ES-03.14.15E-c Terminate non-persistent [Selection (one or more): upon end of session of use; {{ insert: param, A.03.14.15E.ODP.03 }} ] [Assignment: organization-defined system components and services].

controls.label: Tainting
controls.description: Embed data or capabilities in the following systems or system components to determine if CUI has been exfiltrated or improperly removed from the organization: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.label: System-Generated Alerts
controls.description: Alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] when the following system-generated indications of compromise or potential compromise occur: [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.label: Automated Organization-Generated Alerts
controls.description: Alert [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms] when the following indications of inappropriate or unusual activities with security implications occur: [Assignment: organization-defined activities that trigger alerts].

controls.label: Wireless Intrusion Detection
controls.description: Employ a wireless intrusion detection system to identify rogue wireless devices and to detect attack attempts and potential compromises or breaches to the system

controls.label: Security Architecture
controls.description:
ES-03.15.01E-a Develop a security architecture for the system that:
  ES-03.15.01E-a-1 Describes the security requirements and approach to be taken for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of CUI,
  ES-03.15.01E-a-2 Describes how the architecture is integrated into and supports the enterprise architecture, and
  ES-03.15.01E-a-3 Describes any assumptions about, and dependencies on, external systems and services.
ES-03.15.01E-b Review and update the security architecture [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to reflect changes in the enterprise architecture.
ES-03.15.01E-c Reflect planned security architecture changes in system security plans, concept of operations, criticality analysis, organizational procedures, and procurements and acquisitions.

controls.label: Defense In Depth
controls.description:
ES-03.15.02E-a Design the security architecture for the system using a defense-in-depth approach.
ES-03.15.02E-b Allocate [Assignment: organization-defined security requirements] to [Assignment: organization-defined architectural layers and locations].
ES-03.15.02E-c Ensure that the allocated requirements operate in a coordinated and mutually reinforcing manner.

controls.label: Supplier Diversity
controls.description: Require that [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards] allocated to [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards] are obtained from different suppliers.

controls.label: Specialization
controls.description: Employ [Selection (one or more): design; modification; augmentation; reconfiguration] on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] supporting mission-essential services or functions to increase the trustworthiness in those systems or components.

controls.label: Notification Agreements
controls.description: Establish agreements and procedures with entities involved in the supply chain for the system, system component, or system service for the [Selection (one or more): notification of supply chain compromises; results of assessments or audits; {{ insert: param, A.03.17.01E.ODP.02 }} ].

controls.label: Inspection of Systems or Components
controls.description: Inspect the following systems or system components [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] to detect tampering: [Selection (one or more): at random; {{ insert: param, A.03.17.02E.ODP.03 }}; upon {{ insert: param, A.03.17.02E.ODP.04 }} ].

controls.label: Component Authenticity
controls.description:
ES-03.17.03E-a Develop and implement anti-counterfeit policy and procedures that include the means to detect and prevent counterfeit components from entering the system.
ES-03.17.03E-b Report counterfeit system components to [Selection (one or more): source of counterfeit component; {{ insert: param, A.03.17.03E.ODP.02 }}; {{ insert: param, A.03.17.03E.ODP.03 }} ].

controls.label: Provenance
controls.description: Document, monitor, and maintain valid provenance of the following systems, system components, and associated CUI: [Assignment: organization-defined systems, system components, and associated CUI].

controls.label: Supply Chain Integrity – Pedigree
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards] and conduct [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards] to ensure the integrity of the system and system components by validating the internal composition and provenance of critical or mission-essential technologies, products, and services.
